title: Initiative Risk Heatmap & Error-Budget Projection Hub
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Build a centralized Initiative Risk Heatmap and Error-Budget Projection Hub that synthesizes SLIs, recent burn rates, and rollout plans to produce probabilistic runways and risk classifications per initiative. The hub will surface actionable mitigations (auto-throttle, delegated rollback, mitigation playbooks), and provide gating signals for canary/A-B rollouts in the Redwood Console. Goal: reduce surprise SLO breaches by giving PMs and SREs an integrated view and automated recommendations tied to existing rollout/alerting flows.
background: We currently have per-service SLI dashboards and several SLO/initiative trackers, but no unified forecast that ties initiative-level activity (rollouts, experiments, traffic shifts) to error-budget runway under uncertainty. Teams are reacting to SLI spikes without a cross-initiative prioritization plane. This initiative will standardize inputs, run probabilistic projections, and offer a colored risk heatmap to drive planning and pre-emptive mitigations.
goals: Deliver a projection service that computes 7/14/30-day probabilistic error-budget runways for initiatives
Expose a UI heatmap in Console showing initiative risk (Low/Medium/High/Critical) with drilldowns into forecast drivers
Integrate with rollout engine to produce automated throttle/rollback recommendations and safe-fallback actions
Provide exportable artifacts (CSV, ephemeral links) for incident review and roadmap planning meetings
acceptance_criteria: Projection service computes 3 quantiles (p10/p50/p90) for error-budget runway and stores results in telemetry-store
Heatmap UI displays all active initiatives with color-coded risk and supports filter by product area, SLA tier, and owner
Console shows a per-initiative recommended action when p90 runway < 48 hours (e.g., throttle canary, pause rollout, increase capacity)
SRE-runbook links and mitigation checklists are available from the initiative detail pane
Ownership metadata (owner, SLAs, linked PRDs/rollouts) are visible and editable from the initiative card
tasks: Data: define canonical SLI schema and ETL (latency, error-rate, 95th/99th, availability) - coordinate with Instrumentation team
Backend: implement projection microservice (inputs: recent burn rates, change events, traffic deltas) - include Bayesian smoothing and bootstrap uncertainty
API: expose projection endpoints and action recommendations to Console and rollout engine
Console UI: design heatmap, initiative detail view, and action buttons (throttle/rollback/schedule-mitigation)
Runbooks & Playbooks: author mitigation playbooks per risk category and integrate with on-call alert links
E2E: wiring alerts from projection thresholds into PagerDuty and Slack channels; automated short-circuit for critical customer-impact initiatives
design_notes: Heatmap tiles prioritize initiatives by a composite risk score: weighted combination of p90 runway, customer impact, rate of change in SLIs, and rollout intensity
Color palette should be accessible (colorblind-safe); use pattern overlays in addition to color for printed exports
Detail view must surface recent deploys and active experiments that materially impact forecast
implementation_decisions: Use existing telemetry-store (timeseries) as the canonical input; augment with change-event feed from rollout-service
Projection algorithm: lightweight Bayesian exponential smoothing with bootstrap to get quantiles (fast enough for daily recompute across ~200 initiatives), run nightly and on major change events
Recommendations are advisory by default; for P0/P1 customer-impact initiatives the system will surface an explicit suggested action with one-click throttle via rollout API
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: SLI schema variance across services -> Mitigation: implement a normalization layer and fallback heuristics
Risk: False positives from noisy short spikes -> Mitigation: require sustained burn-rate over 6-hour window before triggering 'recommended action'
Risk: Ownership confusion when multiple teams claim an initiative -> Mitigation: enforce single owner metadata and create escalation links to program manager
